Title: Establishes statewide substance abuse prevention and intervention services for all grade levels
Summary: Establishes statewide substance abuse prevention and intervention services for all grade levels; requires a tax on digital asset transactions to fund statewide substance abuse prevention and intervention services.
LawCode: Add §820, Ed L; add Art 12-B §289-g, Tax L
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the education law, in relation to providing substance abuse prevention and intervention services to all grades; and to amend the tax law, in relation to taxing digital asset transactions
